description: This file defines warning reporting categories related to lock contention and reference management within the WPEFramework project. It contains class declarations for 'TooLongWaitingForLock' and 'SinkStillHasReference', each with serialization, deserialization, and string conversion methods, as well as default warning and report bounds.

classes.name: TooLongWaitingForLock
classes.description: Represents a warning category for detecting long wait times to acquire a lock, with serialization and string conversion methods.

classes.name: SinkStillHasReference
classes.description: Represents a warning category for detecting sinks that still hold references during destruction, with serialization and string conversion methods.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the warning data into a byte array.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the warning data from a byte array.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the warning object to a human-readable string.
